subject.title: refactor(qa): finish Matrix QA Lab ownership

question: Should the exact head be authorized to remove the temporary `qa-matrix` package and private runtime facade after the preceding Matrix QA stack lands as reviewed?
rationale: The code and proof support the cleanup, but only a repository owner can confirm the stacked landing order and approve the dependency-graph removal at the current SHA.

options.title: Land stack, then authorize
options.body: Merge the preceding stack in order, refresh this head if necessary, and approve the intentional package and lockfile importer removal for the reviewed SHA.

options.title: Pause the cleanup
options.body: Keep the temporary compatibility package until the preceding stack or its ownership boundary changes are resolved.

recommendation.title: Land stack, then authorize
recommendation.body: Merge the preceding stack in order, refresh this head if necessary, and approve the intentional package and lockfile importer removal for the reviewed SHA.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects steipete to QA Lab, generated plugin documentation, and repository-script boundaries, making them the strongest available routing candidate for the final owner-level authorization.
